Slots.name: host_age_bin
Slots.title: host age bin
Slots.description: Age of host at the time of sampling, expressed as an age group.
Slots.comments: Select the corresponding host age bin from the pick list provided in the template. If not available, provide a null value.

Slots.name: host_gender
Slots.title: host gender
Slots.description: The gender of the host at the time of sample collection.
Slots.comments: Select the corresponding host gender from the pick list provided in the template. If not available, provide a null value. If there is no host, put "Not Applicable".

Slots.name: host_residence_geo_loc_name_country
Slots.title: host residence geo_loc name (country)
Slots.description: The country of residence of the host.
Slots.comments: Select the country name from pick list provided in the template.

Slots.name: host_residence_geo_loc_name_state_province_territory
Slots.title: host residence geo_loc name (state/province/territory)
Slots.description: The state/province/territory of residence of the host.
Slots.comments: Select the province/territory name from pick list provided in the template.

Slots.name: host_subject_id
Slots.title: host subject ID
Slots.description: A unique identifier by which each host can be referred to e.g. #131
Slots.comments: Provide the host identifier. Should be a unique, user-defined identifier.

Slots.name: symptom_onset_date
Slots.title: symptom onset date
Slots.description: The date on which the symptoms began or were first noted.
Slots.comments: ISO 8601 standard "YYYY-MM-DD".

Slots.name: signs_and_symptoms
Slots.title: signs and symptoms
Slots.description: A perceived change in function or sensation, (loss, disturbance or appearance) indicative of a disease, reported by a patient or clinician.
Slots.comments: Select all of the symptoms experienced by the host from the pick list.

Slots.name: preexisting_conditions_and_risk_factors
Slots.title: pre-existing conditions and risk factors
Slots.description: Patient pre-existing conditions and risk factors. <li>Pre-existing condition: A medical condition that existed prior to the current infection. <li>Risk Factor: A variable associated with an increased risk of disease or infection.
Slots.comments: Select all of the pre-existing conditions and risk factors experienced by the host from the pick list. If the desired term is missing, contact the curation team.

Slots.name: complications
Slots.title: complications
Slots.description: Patient medical complications that are believed to have occurred as a result of host disease.
Slots.comments: Select all of the complications experienced by the host from the pick list. If the desired term is missing, contact the curation team.

Slots.name: host_vaccination_status
Slots.title: host vaccination status
Slots.description: The vaccination status of the host (fully vaccinated, partially vaccinated, or not vaccinated).
Slots.comments: Select the vaccination status of the host from the pick list.

Slots.name: number_of_vaccine_doses_received
Slots.title: number of vaccine doses received
Slots.description: The number of doses of the vaccine recived by the host.
Slots.comments: Record how many doses of the vaccine the host has received.

Slots.name: vaccination_dose_1_vaccine_name
Slots.title: vaccination dose 1 vaccine name
Slots.description: The name of the vaccine administered as the first dose of a vaccine regimen.
Slots.comments: Provide the name and the corresponding manufacturer of the COVID-19 vaccine administered as the first dose by selecting a value from the pick list

Slots.name: vaccination_dose_1_vaccination_date
Slots.title: vaccination dose 1 vaccination date
Slots.description: The date the first dose of a vaccine was administered.
Slots.comments: Provide the date the first dose of COVID-19 vaccine was administered. The date should be provided in ISO 8601 standard format "YYYY-MM-DD".

Slots.name: vaccination_dose_2_vaccine_name
Slots.title: vaccination dose 2 vaccine name
Slots.description: The name of the vaccine administered as the second dose of a vaccine regimen.
Slots.comments: Provide the name and the corresponding manufacturer of the COVID-19 vaccine administered as the second dose by selecting a value from the pick list

Slots.name: vaccination_dose_2_vaccination_date
Slots.title: vaccination dose 2 vaccination date
Slots.description: The date the second dose of a vaccine was administered.
Slots.comments: Provide the date the second dose of COVID-19 vaccine was administered. The date should be provided in ISO 8601 standard format "YYYY-MM-DD".

Slots.name: vaccination_dose_3_vaccine_name
Slots.title: vaccination dose 3 vaccine name
Slots.description: The name of the vaccine administered as the third dose of a vaccine regimen.
Slots.comments: Provide the name and the corresponding manufacturer of the COVID-19 vaccine administered as the third dose by selecting a value from the pick list

Slots.name: vaccination_dose_3_vaccination_date
Slots.title: vaccination dose 3 vaccination date
Slots.description: The date the third dose of a vaccine was administered.
Slots.comments: Provide the date the third dose of COVID-19 vaccine was administered. The date should be provided in ISO 8601 standard format "YYYY-MM-DD".

Slots.name: vaccination_dose_4_vaccine_name
Slots.title: vaccination dose 4 vaccine name
Slots.description: The name of the vaccine administered as the fourth dose of a vaccine regimen.
Slots.comments: Provide the name and the corresponding manufacturer of the COVID-19 vaccine administered as the fourth dose by selecting a value from the pick list

Slots.name: vaccination_dose_4_vaccination_date
Slots.title: vaccination dose 4 vaccination date
Slots.description: The date the fourth dose of a vaccine was administered.
Slots.comments: Provide the date the fourth dose of COVID-19 vaccine was administered. The date should be provided in ISO 8601 standard format "YYYY-MM-DD".

Slots.name: vaccination_history
Slots.title: vaccination history
Slots.description: A description of the vaccines received and the administration dates of a series of vaccinations against a specific disease or a set of diseases.
Slots.comments: Free text description of the dates and vaccines administered against a particular disease/set of diseases. It is also acceptable to concatenate the individual dose information (vaccine name, vaccination date) separated by semicolons.

Slots.name: location_of_exposure_geo_loc_name_country
Slots.title: location of exposure geo_loc name (country)
Slots.description: The country where the host was likely exposed to the causative agent of the illness.
Slots.comments: Select the country name from pick list provided in the template.

Slots.name: destination_of_most_recent_travel_city
Slots.title: destination of most recent travel (city)
Slots.description: The name of the city that was the destination of most recent travel.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the city that the host travelled to. Use this look-up service to identify the standardized term: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols/ontologies/gaz

Slots.name: destination_of_most_recent_travel_state_province_territory
Slots.title: destination of most recent travel (state/province/territory)
Slots.description: The name of the province that was the destination of most recent travel.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the state/province/territory that the host travelled to. Use this look-up service to identify the standardized term: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols/ontologies/gaz

Slots.name: destination_of_most_recent_travel_country
Slots.title: destination of most recent travel (country)
Slots.description: The name of the country that was the destination of most recent travel.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the country that the host travelled to. Use this look-up service to identify the standardized term: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols/ontologies/gaz

Slots.name: most_recent_travel_departure_date
Slots.title: most recent travel departure date
Slots.description: The date of a person's most recent departure from their primary residence (at that time) on a journey to one or more other locations.
Slots.comments: Provide the travel departure date.

Slots.name: most_recent_travel_return_date
Slots.title: most recent travel return date
Slots.description: The date of a person's most recent return to some residence from a journey originating at that residence.
Slots.comments: Provide the travel return date.

Slots.name: travel_point_of_entry_type
Slots.title: travel point of entry type
Slots.description: The type of entry point a traveler arrives through.
Slots.comments: Select the point of entry type.

Slots.name: border_testing_test_day_type
Slots.title: border testing test day type
Slots.description: The day a traveller was tested on or after arrival at their point of entry.
Slots.comments: Select the test day.

Slots.name: travel_history
Slots.title: travel history
Slots.description: Travel history in last six months.
Slots.comments: Specify the countries (and more granular locations if known, separated by a comma) travelled in the last six months; can include multiple travels. Separate multiple travel events with a semi-colon. List most recent travel first.

Slots.name: travel_history_availability
Slots.title: travel history availability
Slots.description: The availability of different types of travel history in the last 6 months (e.g. international, domestic).
Slots.comments: If travel history is available, but the details of travel cannot be provided, indicate this and the type of travel history availble by selecting a value from the picklist. The values in this field can be used to indicate a sample is associated with a travel when the "purpose of sequencing" is not travel-associated.

Slots.name: exposure_event
Slots.title: exposure event
Slots.description: Event leading to exposure.
Slots.comments: Select an exposure event from the pick list provided in the template. If the desired term is missing, contact the curation team.

Slots.name: exposure_contact_level
Slots.title: exposure contact level
Slots.description: The exposure transmission contact type.
Slots.comments: Select direct or indirect exposure from the pick-list.

Slots.name: host_role
Slots.title: host role
Slots.description: The role of the host in relation to the exposure setting.
Slots.comments: Select the host's personal role(s) from the pick list provided in the template. If the desired term is missing, contact the curation team.

Slots.name: exposure_setting
Slots.title: exposure setting
Slots.description: The setting leading to exposure.
Slots.comments: Select the host exposure setting(s) from the pick list provided in the template. If a desired term is missing, contact the curation team.

Slots.name: exposure_details
Slots.title: exposure details
Slots.description: Additional host exposure information.
Slots.comments: Free text description of the exposure.

Slots.name: prior_sarscov2_infection
Slots.title: prior SARS-CoV-2 infection
Slots.description: Whether there was prior SARS-CoV-2 infection.
Slots.comments: If known, provide information about whether the individual had a previous SARS-CoV-2 infection. Select a value from the pick list.

Slots.name: prior_sarscov2_infection_isolate
Slots.title: prior SARS-CoV-2 infection isolate
Slots.description: The identifier of the isolate found in the prior SARS-CoV-2 infection.
Slots.comments: Provide the isolate name of the most recent prior infection. Structure the "isolate" name to be ICTV/INSDC compliant in the following format: "SARS-CoV-2/host/country/sampleID/date".

Slots.name: prior_sarscov2_infection_date
Slots.title: prior SARS-CoV-2 infection date
Slots.description: The date of diagnosis of the prior SARS-CoV-2 infection.
Slots.comments: Provide the date that the most recent prior infection was diagnosed. Provide the prior SARS-CoV-2 infection date in ISO 8601 standard format "YYYY-MM-DD".

Slots.name: prior_sarscov2_antiviral_treatment
Slots.title: prior SARS-CoV-2 antiviral treatment
Slots.description: Whether there was prior SARS-CoV-2 treatment with an antiviral agent.
Slots.comments: If known, provide information about whether the individual had a previous SARS-CoV-2 antiviral treatment. Select a value from the pick list.

Slots.name: prior_sarscov2_antiviral_treatment_agent
Slots.title: prior SARS-CoV-2 antiviral treatment agent
Slots.description: The name of the antiviral treatment agent administered during the prior SARS-CoV-2 infection.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the antiviral treatment agent administered during the most recent prior infection. If no treatment was administered, put "No treatment". If multiple antiviral agents were administered, list them all separated by commas.

Slots.name: prior_sarscov2_antiviral_treatment_date
Slots.title: prior SARS-CoV-2 antiviral treatment date
Slots.description: The date treatment was first administered during the prior SARS-CoV-2 infection.
Slots.comments: Provide the date that the antiviral treatment agent was first administered during the most recenrt prior infection. Provide the prior SARS-CoV-2 treatment date in ISO 8601 standard format "YYYY-MM-DD".

Slots.name: purpose_of_sequencing
Slots.title: purpose of sequencing
Slots.description: The reason that the sample was sequenced.
Slots.comments: The reason why a sample was originally collected may differ from the reason why it was selected for sequencing. The reason a sample was sequenced may provide information about potential biases in sequencing strategy. Provide the purpose of sequencing from the picklist in the template. The reason for sample collection should be indicated in the "purpose of sampling" field.

Slots.name: purpose_of_sequencing_details
Slots.title: purpose of sequencing details
Slots.description: The description of why the sample was sequenced providing specific details.
Slots.comments: Provide an expanded description of why the sample was sequenced using free text. The description may include the importance of the sequences for a particular public health investigation/surveillance activity/research question. Suggested standardized descriotions include: Screened for S gene target failure (S dropout), Screened for mink variants, Screened for B.1.1.7 variant, Screened for B.1.135 variant, Screened for P.1 variant, Screened due to travel history, Screened due to close contact with infected individual, Assessing public health control measures, Determining early introductions and spread, Investigating airline-related exposures, Investigating temporary foreign worker, Investigating remote regions, Investigating health care workers, Investigating schools/universities, Investigating reinfection.
Slots.examples: Screened for S gene target failure (S dropout)

Slots.name: sequencing_date
Slots.title: sequencing date
Slots.description: The date the sample was sequenced.
Slots.comments: ISO 8601 standard "YYYY-MM-DD".

Slots.name: library_id
Slots.title: library ID
Slots.description: The user-specified identifier for the library prepared for sequencing.
Slots.comments: The library name should be unique, and can be an autogenerated ID from your LIMS, or modification of the isolate ID.

Slots.name: amplicon_size
Slots.title: amplicon size
Slots.description: The length of the amplicon generated by PCR amplification.
Slots.comments: Provide the amplicon size, including the units.

Slots.name: library_preparation_kit
Slots.title: library preparation kit
Slots.description: The name of the DNA library preparation kit used to generate the library being sequenced.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the library preparation kit used.

Slots.name: flow_cell_barcode
Slots.title: flow cell barcode
Slots.description: The barcode of the flow cell used for sequencing.
Slots.comments: Provide the barcode of the flow cell used for sequencing the sample.

Slots.name: sequencing_instrument
Slots.title: sequencing instrument
Slots.description: The model of the sequencing instrument used.
Slots.comments: Select a sequencing instrument from the picklist provided in the template.

Slots.name: sequencing_protocol_name
Slots.title: sequencing protocol name
Slots.description: The name and version number of the sequencing protocol used.
Slots.comments: Provide the name and version of the sequencing protocol e.g. 1D_DNA_MinION

Slots.name: sequencing_protocol
Slots.title: sequencing protocol
Slots.description: The protocol used to generate the sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide a free text description of the methods and materials used to generate the sequence. Suggested text, fill in information where indicated.: "Viral sequencing was performed following a tiling amplicon strategy using the <fill in> primer scheme. Sequencing was performed using a <fill in> sequencing instrument. Libraries were prepared using <fill in> library kit. "
Slots.examples: Genomes were generated through amplicon sequencing of 1200 bp amplicons with Freed schema primers. Libraries were created using Illumina DNA Prep kits, and sequence data was produced using Miseq Micro v2 (500 cycles) sequencing kits.

Slots.name: sequencing_kit_number
Slots.title: sequencing kit number
Slots.description: The manufacturer's kit number.
Slots.comments: Alphanumeric value.

Slots.name: amplicon_pcr_primer_scheme
Slots.title: amplicon pcr primer scheme
Slots.description: The specifications of the primers (primer sequences, binding positions, fragment size generated etc) used to generate the amplicons to be sequenced.
Slots.comments: Provide the name and version of the primer scheme used to generate the amplicons for sequencing.

Slots.name: raw_sequence_data_processing_method
Slots.title: raw sequence data processing method
Slots.description: The names of the software and version number used for raw data processing such as removing barcodes, adapter trimming, filtering etc.
Slots.comments: Provide the software name followed by the version e.g. Trimmomatic v. 0.38, Porechop v. 0.2.3

Slots.name: dehosting_method
Slots.title: dehosting method
Slots.description: The method used to remove host reads from the pathogen sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide the name and version number of the software used to remove host reads.

Slots.name: consensus_sequence_name
Slots.title: consensus sequence name
Slots.description: The name of the consensus sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide the name and version number of the consensus sequence.

Slots.name: consensus_sequence_filename
Slots.title: consensus sequence filename
Slots.description: The name of the consensus sequence file.
Slots.comments: Provide the name and version number of the consensus sequence FASTA file.

Slots.name: consensus_sequence_filepath
Slots.title: consensus sequence filepath
Slots.description: The filepath of the consensus sequence file.
Slots.comments: Provide the filepath of the consensus sequence FASTA file.

Slots.name: consensus_sequence_software_name
Slots.title: consensus sequence software name
Slots.description: The name of software used to generate the consensus sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the software used to generate the consensus sequence.

Slots.name: consensus_sequence_software_version
Slots.title: consensus sequence software version
Slots.description: The version of the software used to generate the consensus sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide the version of the software used to generate the consensus sequence.

Slots.name: breadth_of_coverage_value
Slots.title: breadth of coverage value
Slots.description: The percentage of the reference genome covered by the sequenced data, to a prescribed depth.
Slots.comments: Provide value as a percent.

Slots.name: depth_of_coverage_value
Slots.title: depth of coverage value
Slots.description: The average number of reads representing a given nucleotide in the reconstructed sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide value as a fold of coverage.

Slots.name: depth_of_coverage_threshold
Slots.title: depth of coverage threshold
Slots.description: The threshold used as a cut-off for the depth of coverage.
Slots.comments: Provide the threshold fold coverage.

Slots.name: r1_fastq_filename
Slots.title: r1 fastq filename
Slots.description: The user-specified filename of the r1 FASTQ file.
Slots.comments: Provide the r1 FASTQ filename.

Slots.name: r2_fastq_filename
Slots.title: r2 fastq filename
Slots.description: The user-specified filename of the r2 FASTQ file.
Slots.comments: Provide the r2 FASTQ filename.

Slots.name: r1_fastq_filepath
Slots.title: r1 fastq filepath
Slots.description: The location of the r1 FASTQ file within a user's file system.
Slots.comments: Provide the filepath for the r1 FASTQ file. This information aids in data management.

Slots.name: r2_fastq_filepath
Slots.title: r2 fastq filepath
Slots.description: The location of the r2 FASTQ file within a user's file system.
Slots.comments: Provide the filepath for the r2 FASTQ file. This information aids in data management.

Slots.name: fast5_filename
Slots.title: fast5 filename
Slots.description: The user-specified filename of the FAST5 file.
Slots.comments: Provide the FAST5 filename.

Slots.name: fast5_filepath
Slots.title: fast5 filepath
Slots.description: The location of the FAST5 file within a user's file system.
Slots.comments: Provide the filepath for the FAST5 file. This information aids in data management.

Slots.name: number_of_base_pairs_sequenced
Slots.title: number of base pairs sequenced
Slots.description: The number of total base pairs generated by the sequencing process.
Slots.comments: Provide a numerical value (no need to include units).

Slots.name: consensus_genome_length
Slots.title: consensus genome length
Slots.description: Size of the reconstructed genome described as the number of base pairs.
Slots.comments: Provide a numerical value (no need to include units).

Slots.name: ns_per_100_kbp
Slots.title: Ns per 100 kbp
Slots.description: The number of N symbols present in the consensus fasta sequence, per 100kbp of sequence.
Slots.comments: Provide a numerical value (no need to include units).

Slots.name: reference_genome_accession
Slots.title: reference genome accession
Slots.description: A persistent, unique identifier of a genome database entry.
Slots.comments: Provide the accession number of the reference genome.

Slots.name: bioinformatics_protocol
Slots.title: bioinformatics protocol
Slots.description: A description of the overall bioinformatics strategy used.
Slots.comments: Further details regarding the methods used to process raw data, and/or generate assemblies, and/or generate consensus sequences can. This information can be provided in an SOP or protocol or pipeline/workflow. Provide the name and version number of the protocol, or a GitHub link to a pipeline or workflow.

Slots.name: lineage_clade_name
Slots.title: lineage/clade name
Slots.description: The name of the lineage or clade.
Slots.comments: Provide the Pangolin or Nextstrain lineage/clade name.

Slots.name: lineage_clade_analysis_software_name
Slots.title: lineage/clade analysis software name
Slots.description: The name of the software used to determine the lineage/clade.
Slots.comments: Provide the name of the software used to determine the lineage/clade.

Slots.name: lineage_clade_analysis_software_version
Slots.title: lineage/clade analysis software version
Slots.description: The version of the software used to determine the lineage/clade.
Slots.comments: Provide the version of the software used ot determine the lineage/clade.

Slots.name: variant_designation
Slots.title: variant designation
Slots.description: The variant classification of the lineage/clade i.e. variant, variant of concern.
Slots.comments: If the lineage/clade is considered a Variant of Concern, select Variant of Concern from the pick list. If the lineage/clade contains mutations of concern (mutations that increase transmission, clincal severity, or other epidemiological fa ctors) but it not a global Variant of Concern, select Variant. If the lineage/clade does not contain mutations of concern, leave blank.

Slots.name: variant_evidence
Slots.title: variant evidence
Slots.description: The evidence used to make the variant determination.
Slots.comments: Select whether the sample was screened using RT-qPCR or by sequencing from the pick list.

Slots.name: variant_evidence_details
Slots.title: variant evidence details
Slots.description: Details about the evidence used to make the variant determination.
Slots.comments: Provide the assay and list the set of lineage-defining mutations used to make the variant determination. If there are mutations of interest/concern observed in addition to lineage-defining mutations, describe those here.
Slots.examples: Lineage-defining mutations: ORF1ab (K1655N), Spike (K417N, E484K, N501Y, D614G, A701V), N (T205I), E (P71L).

Slots.name: gene_name_1
Slots.title: gene name 1
Slots.description: The name of the gene used in the diagnostic RT-PCR test.
Slots.comments: Provide the full name of the gene used in the test. The gene symbol (short form of gene name) can also be provided. Standardized gene names and symbols can be found in the Gene Ontology using this look-up service: https://bit.ly/2Sq1LbI

Slots.name: diagnostic_pcr_protocol_1
Slots.title: diagnostic pcr protocol 1
Slots.description: The name and version number of the protocol used for diagnostic marker amplification.
Slots.comments: The name and version number of the protocol used for carrying out a diagnostic PCR test. This information can be compared to sequence data for evaluation of performance and quality control.

Slots.name: diagnostic_pcr_ct_value_1
Slots.title: diagnostic pcr Ct value 1
Slots.description: The Ct value result from a diagnostic SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR test.
Slots.comments: Provide the CT value of the sample from the diagnostic RT-PCR test.

Slots.name: gene_name_2
Slots.title: gene name 2
Slots.description: The name of the gene used in the diagnostic RT-PCR test.
Slots.comments: Provide the full name of another gene used in an RT-PCR test. The gene symbol (short form of gene name) can also be provided. Standardized gene names and symbols can be found in the Gene Ontology using this look-up service: https://bit.ly/2Sq1LbI

Slots.name: diagnostic_pcr_protocol_2
Slots.title: diagnostic pcr protocol 2
Slots.description: The name and version number of the protocol used for diagnostic marker amplification.
Slots.comments: The name and version number of the protocol used for carrying out a second diagnostic PCR test. This information can be compared to sequence data for evaluation of performance and quality control.

Slots.name: diagnostic_pcr_ct_value_2
Slots.title: diagnostic pcr Ct value 2
Slots.description: The Ct value result from a diagnostic SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR test.
Slots.comments: Provide the CT value of the sample from the second diagnostic RT-PCR test.

Slots.name: gene_name_3
Slots.title: gene name 3
Slots.description: The name of the gene used in the diagnostic RT-PCR test.
Slots.comments: Provide the full name of another gene used in an RT-PCR test. The gene symbol (short form of gene name) can also be provided. Standardized gene names and symbols can be found in the Gene Ontology using this look-up service: https://bit.ly/2Sq1LbI

Slots.name: diagnostic_pcr_protocol_3
Slots.title: diagnostic pcr protocol 3
